run_hf_create_model_repo: run the hf-create-model script to create a new Hugging Face model repository with a GGUF suffix
create_hf_model_with_model_card: create a Hugging Face model repository with an auto-generated model card from a causal template
create_private_hf_model: create a private Hugging Face model repository for a namespace and model name
dry_run_hf_model_creation: dry-run the hf-create-model script to preview repository ID and model card content without creating the repo
create_embedding_model_card: create a Hugging Face model repository using the embedding model card template instead of causal
